messages:
Alex K: Quick heads-up — profiler shows a ~22% tail latency regression on llama2-13b after the rope_theta default drifted in the model catalog. p95 went from ~110ms -> ~135ms on our NV6 pool.
Maria L: I noticed some spikes in the dashboards too. Is the regression isolated to a specific kernel?
Alex K: Looks like it’s tied to the selector choosing the cuda_fast_matmul path for hidden_size=512 / head_dim=64 variants. Kernel timings from a micro-run:
perf-bot: upload: https://perf.redwood/1965432100/llama2-13b-kernel-timings.log
Devin P: Another factor: chat template prefix length increased in the recent tokenizer change — we’re adding ~20-30 tokens for system prompts, which pushes many requests into a different batching bucket. Batcher starts mixing models with different rope_theta and head dims -> bad cache locality.
Maria L: kv-cache metrics show higher miss rate and more frequent evictions during the spike windows. I suspect RoPE theta scaling changed key positions so previously reusable KV keys become mismatched.
Samir: Minimal mitigation that helped in my local run: pin rope_theta per-model to the old constant in the runtime model config. Example override:
```
# runtime model override
model_name: "llama2-13b"
rope_theta: "10000"  # restore old default used by earlier checkpoints
kernel_selector: { policy: "prefer_stable" }
```
Alex K: I also tried temporarily disabling auto-switching in the selector for that model (whitelist the older matmul kernel). That reclaimed ~15% p95 in a dev cluster.
Devin P: Long term we should update the batcher to bucket by (model_version, seq_len_bucket, rope_theta, head_dim) and avoid cross-model batching when rope_theta differs. Also add a fast path that prefers kernels matched to head_dim groups.
Maria L: Agreed. For RMSNorm/SiLU combos we also saw a small perf hit when fused op kernels weren’t selected — selector fallback hits a non-fused implementation. Need a manifest tag for fused ops to bias selection.
Alex K: Plan: (1) open PR to add model-level rope_theta and kernel_selector overrides, (2) batcher change to include rope_theta in grouping, (3) add fused-op tag to kernel registry and a test to ensure selector prefers it for compatible GPUs.
perf-bot: perf/1965432150: candidate-run summary -> baseline p95 110ms, candidate p95 94ms; kv eviction rate down 32% in synthetic chat-heavy suite.
Maria L: Nice. Can we run the candidate across a dedicated NV6 cluster overnight? If results hold we can roll to canary.
Alex K: Will queue the run now. I'll post the PR + before/after graphs in this thread when ready.
Samir: thanks — rough ETA for PR is EOD.
Maria L: :thumbsup:
thread_text_summary: Profiler found p95 regression on llama2-13b after rope_theta default change. Root causes: selector choosing suboptimal kernel for specific head_dim, chat template token growth changing batching buckets, and RoPE scaling causing KV cache misses. Short-term mitigations: pin rope_theta per-model and whitelist kernel; long-term: batcher grouping by rope_theta/head_dim and add fused-op kernel tags. Perf candidate improved p95 and reduced kv evictions.
